newsitem.title: GERMANY: Rain helps prepare German farmland for spring.
newsitem.headline: Rain helps prepare German farmland for spring.

text.p: German winter grain and rapeseed areas have received ample rainfall over the last fortnight which has created good conditions for the spring months, the DWD meteorological office said on Thursday.
"Soils now have enough moisture reserves to cope with warmer temperatures and dry periods in the spring," a DWD source said.
Winter crops were emerging out of dormancy, with daytime temperatures now stable between eight and 12 degrees C.
Frost damage after severe winter weather conditions in early January seemed to be limited and mostly restricted to Mecklenburg and Brandenburg states, the DWD source said.
If the weather stayed mild, farmers would start spring sowings and fertiliser applications in March.
